## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Owner-bound slice only: recoverable launch + subject funding binding per
   the admitted PADR-R5-1* `launch_bound` durable contract (AC-1, AC-2) —
   experiment/budget owner seam (`hh-experiment`, `hh-budget` reuse),
   `measurement.experiment.*` family home, class-table + ontology homes
   reused. Reuse native allocation and the admitted launch-intent
   representation; no second codec/store/class table.
2. Positive: failure injected at every launch persistence boundary recovers
   to exactly one subject/root/slice binding or owned idempotent
   abort/release; frozen task/oracle/grade/funding inputs preserved;
   expose only the admitted binding contract (AC-1).
3. Negative: stale claim, conflicting bytes, orphan root/slice, duplicate
   publication and root-use-before-binding refuse; no cross-run atomicity
   assumed, no second subject; consumer adoption uses the same durable
   writer (AC-2).
4. Ownership/evidence: contributing REQ-D-006/E-201/E-207 predicates/aliases
   resolved to numbered checks + actual evidence; achieved D/E recorded
   separately from owed R/P/actual-execution E; primary owners named, never
   discharged (AC-3).
5. Scoped verification: regression fails without the behavior;
   `cargo fmt --all --check` + owning-package tests; drift/removability/
   CI-gating checks only if their surface is touched; scratch stores (AC-4).
6. Universal phase gate: green in scope; REQ ids stamped; owed predicates as
   DEFERRALS rows with owner/trigger/control; ADRs for owned decisions;
   run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree; O-01–O-08 and I-01–I-08 dispositions
   (AC-5).

## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)

- [ ] AC-1 (D/E; positive): inject failure at every launch persistence
      boundary; recover to exactly one subject/root/slice binding or owned
      idempotent abort/release; frozen inputs preserved; admitted binding
      contract only.
- [ ] AC-2 (D/E; negative): stale claim, conflicting bytes, orphan
      root/slice, duplicate publication, root use before binding refuse; no
      cross-run atomicity, no second subject, same durable writer.
- [ ] AC-3 (D/E; ownership+evidence): contributing targets mapped to
      numbered checks + actual evidence; D/E vs owed recorded.
- [ ] AC-4 (E/D; scoped verification): fails-without regression; fmt +
      owning-package tests; counts recorded; scratch stores.
- [ ] AC-5 (D/E; universal gate): green scope; REQ ids stamped; records
      agree; operating clauses + invariants.

## Plan

1. `crates/hh-ledger/src/classes.rs` — register
   `measurement.experiment.launch_bound` (`row_prov`, measurement family ⇒
   P7 home per `hh-ontology/planes.rs`; HOSTED_LOWERING `"none"`).
2. `crates/hh-experiment/src/events.rs` — `class::LAUNCH_BOUND` +
   `launch_bound{phase:intent|bound|aborted}` payload builders carrying the
   admitted members (`intent_ref, lease_ref, funding_slice_ref,
   subject_root_budget_id, grade_binding{mode,pins_ref,
   selection_policy_ref,instrument_budget_ref}`) plus the engine's linking
   members (`run_plan_id, attempt_no, subject_run_id, subject_head,
   inputs{frozen}`, `released[]`).
3. `crates/hh-experiment/src/view.rs` — `LaunchBinding` fold record on
   `PlanState` (latest phase wins).
4. `crates/hh-experiment/src/errors.rs` — typed refusals
   `LaunchBindingConflict` + `OrphanLaunchFunding`.
5. `crates/hh-experiment/src/engine.rs` — restructure `launch` into the
   admitted order persist-intent → allocate/open → bind subject/root →
   publish → arm:
   - deterministic `intent_ref`/`subject_run_id` via
     `hharness_identity::idp::idp_id` over `(experiment_run, run_plan_id,
     attempt_no)` (S4.6 `sub-<H(…)>` precedent — `open_run_with_id` /
     `has_run` link path);
   - `launch_bound{phase:intent}` appended before any allocation;
   - funding slice adopt-or-allocate by scanning the Account tree for a
     live `slice` node scoped `{Experiment, run_plan_id}` (adopt only under
     a live intent; orphan slices refuse; >1 refuses);
   - subject run link (`has_run` → manifest byte-equality or refuse) or
     `open_run_with_id`; subject writer re-acquired through the same fenced
     `acquire_writer`;
   - atomic subject commit: `control.budget.allocated` subject root (pool
     root mirroring the slice spec, minted mcp-lab style) + `bound` +
     hosted rows — adopted idempotent when already durable;
   - atomic publish commit: `launch_bound{phase:bound}` + `run_launched` +
     `run_bound`;
   - `LaunchPhase` fault seam on `EngineContext` (SpawnHook precedent —
     `Err` simulates the kill at that durable boundary);
   - `abort_launch(run_plan_id)` — owned idempotent abort/release
     (`acct.complete` per live slice + `launch_bound{phase:aborted}`);
   - `launch_binding(run_plan_id)` projection read = the exposed admitted
     contract consumers (R5.7 adoption) validate before root use.
6. `crates/hh-embed/src/experiment_ops.rs` — `lab.experiment.launch`
   response gains `intent_ref`/`subject_root_budget_id` (additive members).
7. `LaunchOutcome` gains `intent_ref` + `subject_root_budget_id`.
8. Tests `crates/hh-experiment/tests/r5_6.rs` — scratch-store acceptance
   battery per the matrix below.
9. ADR-0385 — owned landing decisions (phase encoding, deterministic ids,
   subject-root mirroring, abort op, `mode:"legacy"` grade binding).
